summary: Premium Catering (Holdings) Limited, a Singapore-based Halal caterer listed on Nasdaq under ticker PC, disclosed receipt on September 22, 2026 of a Staff Delisting Determination from Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Department. Nasdaq invoked discretionary authority under Listing Rule IM-5101-4, citing potential third-party manipulation and insufficient liquidity after the SEC suspended trading from October 17–30, 2025 and Nasdaq halted trading effective October 31, 2025 under Rule 4120(a)(5). The Company filed a 6-K on September 28, 2026 and announced intent to request an oral hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel by September 29, 2026. A timely request stays suspension and Form 25-NSE filing, though the trading halt persists absent Nasdaq action. Watch Panel briefing deadlines, possible relisting conditions, and OTC transition risk.
